blocks.text: قاعدة: السؤال والنفي بـ do / does
للسؤال والنفي في المضارع البسيط يُستعمل do (وdoes مع he/she/it): Do you speak English? / He doesn't know.
مع does يعود الفعل إلى أصله بلا s: Does she work? لا Does she works?

sentences.t: Do you have any advice for me?
sentences.ar: هل تريد أن تنصحني بشيء ما ؟

sentences.t: I don't like to cook when it's hot outside.
sentences.ar: لا أحب أن أطبخ عندما يكون الجو حارّاً.

sentences.t: What do you like to eat?
How many pens do you have?
I don't for a moment doubt your honesty.
What do you think you're doing?
How long does it take to get to the station?
sentences.ar: كم من الوقت يلزم للوصول إلى المحطّة.

sentences.t: Don't challenge someone who has nothing to lose.
sentences.ar: لا تتحدى من ليس لديه ما يخسره.

sentences.t: Don't argue when you are angry and don't eat when you are full.
sentences.ar: لا تجادل وانت غضبان ولا تأكل وانت شبعان.

sentences.t: I do hope you'll come again.
Don't forget that we have homework.

sentences.ar: على المرء أن يفعل كلّ ما بوسعه.

sentences.t: All you have to do is to learn this sentence by heart.
sentences.ar: كل ما عليك فعله هو حفظ هذه الجملة عن ظهر قلب.

sentences.t: I don't know when he'll be here.
No, I don't have it with me.
